messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed staging worker startup logs printing the entire ENV object, incl REDWOOD_API_KEY and DB_URL. Not sure when this started, saw it in the job logs.
kevin: Yikes. Can you paste the exact log line or a small snippet?
maya: Sure, from the pod logs:
```
INFO 2026-03-15T14:02:10Z worker.main: Starting worker with env: {"REDWOOD_API_KEY": "sk-prod-abc123...", "DB_URL": "postgres://user:pass@host/db", "FEATURE_FLAG": "on"}
```
sam: That's definitely a secret leak. We should never stringify env like that. Is this using the new worker image (v2.4.1)?
maya: Yes v2.4.1, it's from the startup debug wrapper we added back in Feb to diagnose cold-starts. I guess it was left enabled in staging.
julia: Policy check: logging any complete secret material is disallowed. Even staging keys are sensitive. Please rotate any keys that were exposed in logs, and treat them as compromised until rotated.
kevin: Quick mitigation: roll patch to remove the debug log and rotate the exposed REDWOOD_API_KEY. Also enable the logger redaction setting (logger_config: {"redact_env": true}) in the image so this can't happen again.
deploy-bot: Deployment staging/worker v2.4.1 -> rollback triggered by kevin at 2026-03-15T14:05:12Z :warning:
maya: Will open PR to strip the env dump and add redact flag. Also will scrub logs from the pod and request retention purge for that timeframe. Any guidance on rotation process for these keys?
julia: For hosted API keys: create a new key in the Admin Console, update services to use new key, then revoke the old one. Note: update any CI secrets/terraform state referencing it. For DB_URL: rotate the DB password with security-approved rotation flow (ticket or runbook) and update the connection string in Vault.
sam: Suggest using short-lived tokens for worker-to-api calls in the future. We can integrate Vault Agent or use KMS to decrypt ephemeral creds on startup so they never appear in clear.
kevin: Short-term: maya, can you paste the PR link when created and tag @sam and @julia for review? Also create a minimal incident note in #incidents with what was leaked and rotation status.
maya: Will do. PR will remove the dump, add redact_env, and add a unit test to prevent printing env in logs. I'll also rotate the exposed key and post updates here.
julia: Thanks — after rotation, file the evidence in the security rotation checklist and close the loop. If anyone touched logs, request retention purge via infra ticket.
kevin: One extra item: add a linter rule that flags use of logging the result of os.environ or os.getenv dump. We had a similar slip a year ago.
maya: Good call. I'll add a repo-level pre-commit hook + CI check.
sam: If helpful I can draft the Vault/KMS short-lived token pattern for the team next week.
maya: That would be great, thanks :pray:
julia: Marking this resolved in thread once rotation + purge + PR merged. Keep me posted.
